title: BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W Solar Kit (2026): What 1,152 Wh Runs and How Fast It Refills
short_title: BLUETTI AC180 solar kit: how long the 200 W panel takes
summary: The BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W solar panel kit from BLUETTI's US store: 1,152 Wh LiFePO4, 1,800 W inverter, 500 W of solar input. What it runs, how long the 200 W panel takes to refill it, what Power Lifting does, and how it compares with the other 1 kWh kits (ALLPOWERS P1800, Jackery 1000 v2, EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic).
short_summary: BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit: 1,152 Wh of LiFePO4 that the included panel refills in most of a sunny day.

long.say: The BLUETTI AC180 with a two-hundred-watt panel is one of the few one-kilowatt-hour solar kits you can buy in one box. Here's what it runs and how fast the panel refills it, from BLUETTI's own US page. Quick note: if you buy through the link in the description, Dealectric earns a commission, at no cost to you.

long.say: The specs. Eleven hundred fifty-two watt-hours of LiFePO4 battery. An eighteen-hundred-watt inverter, with what BLUETTI calls Power Lifting up to twenty-seven hundred watts for resistive loads. One two-hundred-watt folding panel. And a solar input of up to five hundred watts, at twelve to sixty volts. The station carries a five-year warranty.

rows: 1,800 W (2,700 W Power Lifting, resistive loads)

long.chapter: How fast the panel refills it
long.say: How fast does the panel refill it? A two-hundred-watt folding panel delivers about a hundred twenty to a hundred fifty watts in good sun. That's about eight to ten hours of good sun for the full battery: most of a sunny day. BLUETTI's own three-hour figure assumes the full five hundred watts of panel, so a second panel is the way to faster refills.

slide.cap: of good sun for the 200 W panel to refill 1,152 Wh
slide.note: BLUETTI's 3 h figure assumes the full 500 W of panel

long.say: What does eleven hundred fifty-two watt-hours run? Roughly four times what a small three-hundred-watt-hour station does: about eighty phone charges, a fifteen-watt laptop for two and a half days, or a CPAP without its humidifier for three to four nights. A twelve-volt compressor fridge, at about point seven kilowatt-hours a day, runs for about a day and a half.

slide.note: Estimates scaled from our 288 Wh figures; inverter losses vary

long.say: And the eighteen-hundred-watt inverter? It runs a microwave or a coffee maker. Power Lifting lets resistive loads above that, like a kettle or a hair dryer, run at reduced power instead of tripping the station. They'll work, just more slowly.

items: Microwave, coffee maker, power tools under 1,800 W
Kettles and hair dryers run at reduced power

long.say: Against the other one-kilowatt-hour kits, the AC180 kit has the most battery. ALLPOWERS' P1800 kit ships twice the panel, four hundred watts, and takes six hundred fifty watts of solar, but it was a pre-order when we checked. Jackery's Solar Generator 1000 v2 has a smaller fifteen-hundred-watt inverter and takes only four hundred watts of solar.
